verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI advertises simple Google-account sign-in with no API key management (gh-13), but hands-on developer reports say that existing paid Gemini subscriptions don't actually unlock CLI usage/benefits — users must separately buy 'Gemini Code Assist Standard/Enterprise' and describe the subscription model as fragmented and confusing (comm-3, comm-19, comm-2). Missing for 10: clear first-party mapping of which subscription tiers grant CLI quota/benefits, and confirmation that a standard Gemini Pro subscriber gets expanded CLI usage.
